S01: AI can help you write code faster. But when something changes, how do you know what happened, what it affects, and whether it's ready to ship?
S02: Meet FailSafe. A development companion that helps solo developers keep their work visible, understand potential risks, and maintain a record of important decisions.
S02B: Setup starts in the Console. Install the Qor-Logic skills, approve the request in VS Code, and the workspace is ready.
S03: With version 6.0.12, the Console, Monitor, and SRE views share a consistent visual experience. Change your theme, and your workspace follows. The information stays familiar, wherever you're working.
S04: Now imagine a small but important bug. A date validator accepts a day that doesn't exist. We document the issue, write a regression test, and see the failure for ourselves.
S05: Fixing the code is only part of the job. FailSafe helps surface the risks and governance requirements around a change, so the developer knows what still needs attention.
S06: The corrected validator passes its tests. We can inspect the difference, see the recorded decisions, and compare the result with what we intended to change.
S07: Every change has a story. What we set out to do, what we changed, what we checked, and what still needs review. FailSafe helps make that story easier to follow.
S08: Move faster without losing sight of the work. FailSafe. Build with AI. Know what changed.
